name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
description: DevDigest AI-engineering harness: reusable skills, agents, hooks and SDD workflows for Claude Code

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Shared technical skills (security, TypeScript, React/Next.js, Fastify, Drizzle, Postgres, Zod, architecture, diagrams) with one home for every plugin that needs them

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only researcher agent that answers one concrete question from the codebase or external sources, with cited evidence

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Read-only architecture reviewer that checks a diff against the project's own layer and package boundary rules

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec Driven Development workflow: spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer and plan-verifier agents, /run-plan orchestration and /workflow-retro

plugins.name: flaky-fix
plugins.description: Flaky test triage without extra pipeline runs: scripts scope the stack trace and candidate commits, read-only agents find the cause and review the fix, a guard hook confines every write
